digest_tree_unification.rationale: hkdf 0.12.4, argon2 0.5.3, blake2 0.10.6, and chacha20poly1305 0.10.1 were pinned to the versions sharing the digest 0.10 and crypto-common 0.1 generation already used by the admitted sha2 0.10.9 and hmac 0.12.1, so no second copy of the RustCrypto trait stack enters the graph.

feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.name: windows-sys
feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.justification: Supplies NCryptCreateProtectionDescriptor, NCryptProtectSecret, NCryptUnprotectSecret, and NCryptFreeBuffer for the Windows DPAPI-CNG broker. No new package, and no networking API is reachable through this feature.

feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.name: tokio
feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.justification: The keystore leaf runs each Secret Service conversation on a dedicated thread with its own current-thread runtime, so the facade stays callable from a synchronous caller and from inside the daemon runtime. No new package and no new socket: zbus reaches the session bus over the same local Unix-domain-socket capability tokio already holds.

feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.name: zeroize
feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.justification: Promoted from an existing transitive to a direct dependency. It is the zeroization boundary ADR-005 requires, and derive supplies the ZeroizeOnDrop bound the key types assert.

feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.name: subtle
feature_reviews_of_already_admitted_pack.justification: Promoted from an existing transitive to a direct dependency for the constant-time recipient-record MAC comparison KY06 requires.

network_posture: No dependency admitted here opens an outbound socket. zbus speaks only to the session D-Bus over a local Unix-domain socket owned by the user, matching the local-IPC posture already admitted for tokio and rustix.
advisory_path: RustSec and crates.io advisories, GitHub security advisories, and upstream release notices, triaged as reviewed commits through this same admission process. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request, so no automatic bump can bypass the review.

admissions.name: argon2
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Derives the recovery recipient wrapping key; a password KDF must not be hand-written, and this is the reference RustCrypto implementation.

admissions.name: async-broadcast

admissions.name: async-recursion

admissions.name: async-trait
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Async trait desugaring for zbus; build-time only.

admissions.name: blake2
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Argon2 internal compression function; never called directly by this workspace.

admissions.name: chacha20
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: The stream cipher inside chacha20poly1305.

admissions.name: chacha20poly1305
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: XChaCha20-Poly1305 is the wrap AEAD of the recipient record and the aead_id = 1 of the t068 section 3.4 object format, so P2-K3 inherits the same reviewed primitive.

admissions.name: cipher

admissions.name: endi

admissions.name: enumflags2_derive

admissions.name: event-listener-strategy
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Blocking and async strategy wrapper over event-listener; not an executor.

admissions.name: event-listener
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Synchronisation primitive used by zbus; not an executor.

admissions.name: futures-io
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: AsyncRead and AsyncWrite trait definitions used by zbus; trait definitions only.

admissions.name: futures-lite
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Small future combinators used by zbus. No reactor is started: the tokio feature routes all I/O through the already-admitted tokio.

admissions.name: hkdf

admissions.name: inout
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: In-place buffer handling used by cipher so a stream cipher can transform a buffer without a second allocation.

admissions.name: memoffset

admissions.name: opaque-debug

admissions.name: ordered-stream

admissions.name: parking

admissions.name: password-hash
admissions.trust_boundary_justification: Required by the argon2 alloc feature; only its allocation traits are reached, and this crate produces and parses no PHC string.

admissions.name: poly1305
